name: crates
description: Two honey-oak crates, a small one stacked square on a big one, with a coil of thick twisted rope in front and a tied burlap sack beside them. Each crate has square corner posts, rails, recessed vertical planks, a diagonal brace on each side and a raised lid frame round recessed slats, with grain along every board and nails at every joint.

parts.description: A smaller crate stacked square on the big one, set back.
A coil of thick twisted rope.
